beforeFix.cause: MFA precondition compared expiry with request time captured before waiting for the conditional User write

correction.behavior: Revalidate source-session deadlines and MFA preconditions with a fresh time after the User row lock is acquired

limits: Next cookies and request headers simulated; no middleware or real cookie transport
Fixture deadlines shortened, no global clock replacement; PostgreSQL lock waits observed
Bcrypt fixture cost 4, not a production hashing benchmark
Two-request races only; no load or multi-process capacity benchmark
Browser, CSRF, safe-next routing and lost HTTP responses belong to separate integration benches
